electronics_access.retention_detail: Four discrete integral corner bosses are the panel's only bearing surfaces. Each boss has a 9 mm root into its adjacent front/rear fixed roof edge; the rear roots fill the rear-wall thickness. The −X pair connect into the sidewall. The +X pair also have full-depth 9 mm roots into the +X fixed roof, supporting each boss on two sides. Four recessed M3x12 screws engage RX-M3x5.7 heatsets. No perimeter rim.
electronics_access.assembly_purpose: Connect the rear-wall C14 inlet to the cold-core-mounted Mean Well through the open electronics bay, then install the empty panel last.

upstream_handoff.scope: The plain guide is an ownership boundary in one continuous tube. It adds no cut, socket or insertion; the core internal span and external rise meet at this plane.

soda_route.scope: Continuous supported insulated inlet with an estimated15.7mm meter insertion. The plain guide adds no joint or cut. The rear concealed join and19.2958mm return stem retain their selected datums. Physical receiving depth, sealing and retention are unqualified.

The meter, directly seated inlet stem and vertical inlet span belong to the cold core; the nested rear stems and concealed outlet span belong to back-top.

placement_status.vb_return: V-B stands at native [38,244.90434,280.41]. Its level direct-stem inlet has a 10.95 mm exposed tube. The 8-degree raised outlet crosses at Y280.69954 to the return union at X−50/Z294.3305696773. A 3 mm crowned return with R30.31345 minimum reaches the retained Y-B pose; J10 screwdriver access and bounded J11 housing service remain open.
placement_status.va_outlet: The V-A lower outlet stem is clocked 5 degrees aft about its vertical seated axis. The under-head tube has an 86.18 mm minimum radius and 1.139 mm native clearance to the core B-fill union.
